description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects create/registration-time reentrancy: a create/mint/register/list/deposit/stake flow performs a callback-yielding external interaction (safeMint / ERC721/1155 safeTransfer receiver callback / external hook / low-level call) BEFORE committing the registration/limit/accounting state, with no reentrancy guard — so a reentrant call observes partially-initialized state (e.g. a stale per-address mint counter) and bypasses the invariant. 4-signal gate: S1 create-verb fn + S2 callback-yielding interaction + S3 state-commit AFTER the callback (CEI violation) + S4 no nonReentrant. Anchor: nextgen H-01 (NextGenCore.mint -> _mintProcessing -> _safeMint before tokensMintedPerAddress += 1, no guard). Scope: callback-before-commit in create flows ONLY; does NOT detect generic reentrancy, cross-contract stale-check reentrancy (e.g. reNFT H-03 Seaport-mediated), or read-only reentrancy.
_removed_ambiguous: P242 fix: dropped 'safetransferfrom'/'safetransfer('/.call( - ERC20 SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom-before-_mint is the INTENTIONAL CEI-safe deposit pattern (pooltogether/sentiment/concrete/reserve FPs); ERC20 transferFrom triggers no recipient callback. Kept ERC721-1155-specific receiver callbacks (_safeMint/safeBatchTransferFrom/onERCxReceived) + arbitrary .call{value}.

fp_controls.four_signal_required: S1 create-verb fn AND S2 callback-yielding interaction AND S3 a state-commit textually AFTER the S2 call site AND S4 no nonReentrant. A CEI-correct flow (state committed before the callback) or a guarded fn is suppressed.
fp_controls.ordering_based: S3 requires the state write to appear AFTER the callback call index in the body (a true callback-before-commit ordering), not merely co-present.
fp_controls.guard_suppression: any nonReentrant / ReentrancyGuard / mutex on the function -> suppressed.
fp_controls.known_blind_spots: cross-CONTRACT stale-check reentrancy (the check in a different contract than the callback) and Seaport/conduit-mediated transfers are not detected by this per-function source classifier.
